items.title: Links that lead off-site now open in your real browser
items.text: Clicking a link out to another site from a live page (a dev server, a local HTML mock) used to follow it inside the pane, where Ghoztty's own cookie jar meant anything behind a login rendered logged-out. Cross-origin links now hand off to your default browser, so signing in works. Clicking around inside the same dev server or through a mock's own pages is untouched — that's what live pages are for.

items.title: Every link gets Ghoztty's right-click menu
items.text: On any page, including sites we don't control, right-clicking a link offers the same actions a banner link does: open in a side pane, open in a new window, copy the link or path. The Cmd / Cmd-Shift modifiers work there too. Your text selection is respected — right-clicking inside a selection still gives you Copy and Look Up.

items.title: `+rearrange` can place viewer panes
items.text: A layout that named a viewer pane failed with "pane is no longer alive," about a pane `+list` had just reported, which left any window holding a preview pane permanently un-rearrangeable. Viewer panes now rearrange like any other, keep their content and scroll position, and focus lands where the layout asked.
